def eyes():
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sr=[r for r in range(64) if 'S' in lines[r]]
    r=sr[0]; cs=[c for c in range(64) if lines[r][c]=='S']
    return sr[0], min(cs), max(cs)
def test(name):
    action(['SPACE'])
    print(name, 'level',current_frame.level,'done?',last_action_result.get('done'),'lc?',last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if current_frame.level!=2 or last_action_result.get('done'): raise SystemExit
action(['DOWN']*2+['RIGHT']*4); print('pos',eyes()); test('at (26,22)')
action(['DOWN']); print('pos',eyes()); test('at (30,22)')
action(['LEFT']*4+['UP']*6+['RIGHT']*5); print('pos',eyes()); test('at (6,26)')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
